Reference / locale/tag

locale/tag#

Locales: BCP 47 language tags (RFC 5646), checked and canonical.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let locale = Locale("de-CH");
locale.language();                          // "de"
locale.region();                            // "CH"
Locale(language: "zh", script: "Hant", region: "TW", variants: []).string();   // "zh-Hant-TW"
LocaleExtensions(Locale("th-TH-u-nu-thai")).unicode();

Description#

Locales: BCP 47 language tags (RFC 5646), checked and canonical.

Tags are case-normalized and replaced by their IANA preferred values (iw becomes he). Bad tags are InvalidLocale with the offset.
